notes.title: Update 0.2!

I spent a few days working on all these changes, so I hope you enjoy them![/p][p][/p][h2]VERY IMPORTANT[/h2][p]TO PLAY THIS UPDATE, YOU MUST DELETE YOUR SAVE FILE. THIS CAN BE FOUND IN C:\\Users\\<your name>\\Documents\\Cargo\\Saves. IF YOU DO NOT DELETE YOUR SAVE, THE GAME WILL NOT FUNCTION (This is not intentional)[/p][p][/p][h1]Changes[/h1][list][*][p]Added inventory system (very big!!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new tools and resources (not usable yet, but will be in the future!)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed save system (A few small bugs)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new data to save[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed XP gain (XP is now more difficult to get, hopefully)[/p][/*][*][p]Added sleeping and beds (To sleep, it has to be past 18:00, there currently is no clock, but I'm planning to add that next update)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Reporting Bugs[/h2][p]If you wish to report a bug to me, join the Discord by clicking the button below and fill out a report in #bugs.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/EkPG5Pc892"]Click to join[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Suggesting Changes/Features[/h2][p]You can suggest a feature on the Google Form by clicking the button below.[/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/2YuzMQpeC3mPSYfF6" style="button"]Submit a Feature[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Have fun and happy gaming!![/b][/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: V2.0A IS HERE!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that V2.0Alpha is finally out! As you may have seen from the thumbnail, we have added ALOT. For beginners:

[h1]Missions[/h1]
The main element to Cargo. Will, the missions NPC allows you to accept or decline missions to collect.

[h1]The Grid System[/h1]
Allows you to easily locate packages. Since we used Facepunch.Steamworks for Steam integration, we thought it would be fitting to use a similar grid system to Facepunch's own game, Rust.

[h1]The Shop[/h1]
The shop allows you to buy fuel, wood, or power-ups such as:
[list]
[*] Quickfeet (Allows you to sprint)
[*] Longlegs (Doubles your movement speed and sprint speed if Quickfeet is unlocked)
[/list]

We are hoping to add alot more as time passes. I say we like I own a studio, so I have some kinda bad news. I am a solo dev. I am also a sophmore in high school, so I don't get alot of sleep or I sleep during the day which results in me not getting any dev work done. I try to when I can but i'm hopeful that I can get the game ready for release in May at the earliest.

I can't wait to add more elements to this game for everyone and to finally release it. Enjoy the Alpha phase!

[b]One more thing[/b]
I have decided to remove mutliplayer from the game indefinitly, or atleast until I can get a good standing on the game.

notes.title: V0.1.1 Update
notes.content:
V0.1.1 is the first public update I have created and pushed. And with that, I have added a few things. Note that this game is still very much in development so there is no current gameplay loop or anything like that, just some basic sandbox shit. Heres what I added:

[list]
[*] Added singleplayer
[*] Semi-fixed multiplayer bug that caused host to crash
[/list]

Enjoy the singleplayer while I fix multiplayer!
